name: What are the benefits of a handheld showerhead compared to a fixed showerhead?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of a handheld showerhead compared to a fixed showerhead?

acceptedAnswer.text: Handheld showerheads offer increased flexibility and convenience compared to fixed units. Key benefits include easier cleaning of the shower area, improved accessibility for bathing children or pets, and targeted rinsing. They are particularly useful for individuals with mobility challenges or those seeking a more adaptable showering experience. Fixed showerheads provide a consistent, hands-free spray, which some prefer for a simpler showering routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: Handheld showerheads offer flexibility for cleaning, bathing children/pets, and targeted rinsing. Fixed units provide a hands-free spray.
